interpretation: The 144 seed-question outcomes repeat 48 questions across three fixed initializations. The bootstrap resamples 24 whole families and is not a confidence interval over arbitrary seeds. limits: Exact retained artifact chunks spill between arms and restore one arm at a time. Sampled whole-harness peak RSS must remain within the unchanged 768 MiB work reservation; this is measured evidence, not an OS hard limit.
48 questions in 24 whole construction families repeat for three fixed lower initializations. 144 outcomes are not 144 independent mathematical questions.
The family bootstrap averages over these three fixed seeds and resamples 24 declared families. It is not a confidence interval over arbitrary initialization seeds.
The source grammar has four bounded operation recipes and shared declared helper prerequisites. Added construction steps do not guarantee greater mathematical difficulty in every recipe.
The upper model learns values for bounded compositions of implemented data, objective and step-size choices. It does not invent arbitrary algorithms, modify the calculus or authorize proofs.
The 48 outer trials have additional full-system cost. Equal final arm ceilings, equal 24 outer-trial counts, and equal 192 upper updates do not imply equal actual or lifetime compute.

The fresh-parent upper controller is a causal control with the same 24 real trials and 192 upper updates as continuation. This differs from the prior study 48 trials for a single controller; cross-study aggregate differences are not causal evidence.

Continuation source epochs are frozen by the initial source producer before optimizer calls so all fork comparisons share exact checked inputs. This isolates training-state handling and does not measure the production adaptive question selector.

A warm 250-update parent, a 500-update candidate, two valid promotions or a 500-update retained model establish mechanism events, not independent outcome gain. Missing genuine warm contexts means incomplete intervention coverage.
The existing checked-anchor rehearsal and pairwise preference objectives remain unchanged. No additional lower stability constraint is included; this trial isolates continuation-state meta-training.
The secondary 128-expansion condition also adds exploration, so it is not a monotonic budget-only comparison.
Ordinary autonomous questions use the maintained bounded grammar and checked graph proposals. This trial does not qualify semantic interest assessment or unrestricted mathematical discovery.
Development promotion, local restart/gossip integration, held-out quality, hosted CI and physical deployment are separate evidence layers.

Outer novel acquisition families are partitioned from final novel acquisition families; meta outcomes use the shared development gate. The fixed transfer panel is shared by outer rewards and final lower gates and is not an unseen reward panel. Independent final outcomes are never meta-training labels.

All 144 previous final questions remain retired diagnostics and are excluded from new training and final-family selection. No revealed final result authorizes tuning or an automatic successor experiment.

Standalone learned-system cost allocations each include all shared outer inputs and conservatively all residual orchestration; they cannot be summed to infer physical cost because shared setup physically ran once.
Local operation, held-out quality, hosted MR CI, release-candidate packaging, complete Full Cargo qualification and physical deployment remain distinct evidence layers.
The final receipt commit needs its own exact-head hosted checks. This receipt records immutable scientific-source checks and deliberately avoids a circular final commit hash.
Complete Full Cargo matrix, software release, physical multiple-host operation and production deployment are not qualified.
